sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IN MID/UPPER LEVELS...MEAN TROUGHING IS EXPECTED TO AMPLIFY OVER ERN 1/2-2/3 OF CONUS AS SERIES OF SHORTWAVE PERTURBATIONS TRAVERSE EXTENSIVE CYCLONIC-FLOW FIELD THAT EXTENDS FROM NRN/CENTRAL ROCKIES ACROSS MS VALLEY TO ATLC COAST. LONG-LIVED CYCLONE CURRENTLY OVER FAR NRN ONT IS FCST TO CONTRACT AND SHIFT SLOWLY ESEWD ACROSS JAMES BAY THROUGH PERIOD...PHASING WITH STRENGTHENING SHORTWAVE TROUGH THAT WILL MOVE SEWD FROM DAKOTAS ACROSS MN/WI/IA. DOWNSTREAM...MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY INDICATES POSITIVELY TILTED SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND VORTICITY AXIS FROM OH TO NRN LA. THIS FEATURE SHOULD MOVE EWD TO MID ATLC...CAROLINAS AND VA BY 00Z...THEN EXTEND FROM SRN NEW ENGLAND COAST OVER COASTAL CAROLINAS TO SRN GA BY 12Z. WEAK LARGE-SCALE LIFT AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE WILL SUPPORT GEN TSTM POTENTIAL TODAY OVER ATLC COAST STATES AND CENTRAL/SRN APPALACHIANS...THOUGH LAPSE RATES AND VERTICAL SHEAR EACH LOOK TOO WEAK FOR ORGANIZED SVR. AT SFC...11Z ANALYSIS SHOWED LEADING SYNOPTIC FRONTAL ZONE FROM GULF OF MAINE SWWD THROUGH WEAK FRONTAL-WAVE LOW OVER CHESAPEAKE BAY TO MID TN...BECOMING QUASISTATIONARY FROM SERN AR WSWWD ACROSS N-CENTRAL TX THEN WNWWD OVER ERN/CENTRAL NM. AS POSITIVELY TILTED MID/UPP

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION WAS EVIDENT FROM W-CENTRAL MO WNWWD NEAR EMP-SLN-HLC LINE TO BETWEEN CBK-MCK. OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS STALLED W OF SLN AND SHOULD DO SO SOON ACROSS ERN KS...GIVEN GEN SHRINKING/WEAKENING OF CAUSATIVE CONVECTION OVER WRN MO ATTM. COLD FRONT IS EXPECTED TO OVERTAKE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM W-E THIS AFTN AS LATTER MOVES SLOWLY NWD AND BECOMES SOMEWHAT MORE DIFFUSE ON ITS W END. STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER LIFT ON VARIOUS SCALES...FROM FRONTOGENETIC AND DIABATIC NEAR SFC TO DCVA/LARGE-SCALE FORCING ALOFT...SHOULD SUPPORT SCATTERED TSTMS DEVELOPMENT NEAR COLD FRONT THIS AFTN AND PERHAPS INVOF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AS WELL. AIR MASS S OF BOTH COLD FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL BE SUBJECT TO STRONGEST SFC HEATING AND DEEPEST BOUNDARY-LAYER MIXING...ULTIMATELY SUPPORTING WIND POTENTIAL FROM CONVECTION THAT MOVES THROUGH IT -- EVEN FOR A FEW HOURS AFTER DARK BEFORE NEAR-SFC/DIABATICALLY STABILIZING LAYER BECOMES TOO DEEP. EARLY-STAGE CONVECTION SHOULD INCLUDE MIXTURE OF SUPERCELLS AND MULTICELLS...WITH FORMER OFFERING POTENTIALLY VERY LARGE/DAMAGING HAIL GIVEN EXPECTED 1.5-INCH PW/INFLOW-LAYER MOISTURE CONTENT...FAVORABLE BUOYANCY...AND 35-45 KT EFFECTIVE-SHEA

outlooks.summary: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD FORM OVER NORTHERN KANSAS AND SOUTHERN NEBRASKA THIS AFTERNOON WITH LARGE/DAMAGING HAIL AND A RISK OF A TORNADO OR TWO. THE ACTIVITY WILL SHIFT SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS KANSAS AND INTO SOUTHWESTERN MISSOURI AFTER DARK.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF NEB/KS/MO
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE CENTRAL PLAINS...

sections.title: NEB/KS/MO
sections.text: BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW IS BECOMING ESTABLISHED OVER THE NORTHERN PLAINS STATES...WITH SEVERAL MINOR IMPULSES TRACKING ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND INTO THE PLAINS. ONE FEATURE NOW OVER WY WILL MOVE INTO SD/NEB THIS EVENING. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT IN ADVANCE OF THE SYSTEM WILL AID IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS BY MID AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF CENTRAL NEB. THESE STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP SOUTHEASTWARD ALONG AND SOUTH OF A WEAK REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS INTO NORTHERN KS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN THIS REGION SHOW STEEP LOW AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...WITH AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2000 J/KG. LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE RATHER WEAK...BUT VEERING/INCREASING WINDS WITH HEIGHT AND FAST FLOW AT UPPER LEVELS WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STORM STRUCTURES. LARGE HAIL APPEARS TO BE THE MAIN RISK THROUGH MUCH OF THE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING...ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE. VERY LARGE HAIL IS POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST SUPERCELLS. DURING THE EVENING...OUTFLOWS ARE EXPECTED TO CONGEAL...WITH AN INCREASING RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: IA/IL/ERN MO
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ROTATING ACROSS IA/MO. LIFT NEAR THE TROUGH AXIS MAY HELP TO INITIATE A FEW STRONG THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON OVER SOUTHEAST IA AND NORTHEAST MO...TRACKING INTO NORTHERN IL. SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR VALUES AND COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT MAY RESULT IN HAIL OR GUSTY WINDS IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART/BROYLES.. 09/10/2015

outlooks.summary: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD FORM OVER NORTHERN KANSAS AND SOUTHERN NEBRASKA THIS AFTERNOON WITH LARGE/DAMAGING HAIL AND A RISK OF A TORNADO OR TWO. THE ACTIVITY WILL SHIFT SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS KANSAS AND INTO SOUTHWESTERN MISSOURI AFTER DARK. ONLY MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE EXISTING OUTLOOK. THE 18Z TOP RAOB --MODIFIED FOR OBSERVED SURFACE CONDITIONS-- SHOWED A MOIST/CONDITIONALLY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER WITH LITTLE CINH REMAINING. THE STEEP H7-H5 LAPSE RATE /7.7 DEG C PER KM/ WILL FAVOR HAIL GROWTH WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS ONCE SURFACE-BASED CI OCCURS LATER THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO REMAIN WEAK --THEREBY LIMITING THE OVERALL TORNADO RISK-- LARGE VEERING IN FLOW INVOF FRACTURED FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL YIELD 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION. FOR THE ABOVE REASONS...HAVE KEPT THE FORECAST LARGELY UNCHANGED FROM THE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK UPDATE. ..SMITH.. 09/10/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1120 AM CDT THU SEP 10 2015/

sections.title: KS INTO WRN MO
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE CURRENTLY ONGOING ACROSS MUCH OF KS AND WILL EVENTUALLY AFFECT WRN MO LATER THIS EVENING. STORMS HAVE REMAINED LARGELY CELLULAR WITH VERY LARGE HAIL REPORTED AS WELL AS LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS. WITH TIME...STORMS SHOULD MERGE INTO LARGER CLUSTERS WITH DAMAGING WINDS BECOMING A CONCERN MAINLY ACROSS ERN KS AND WRN MO. OTHER SEVERE STORMS WITH A MARGINAL HAIL RISK PERSIST ACROSS SWRN KS WITH THREAT EXTENDING INTO THE NRN TX PANHANDLE THIS EVENING. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS 1795 AND 1796.

sections.title: SRN GA...ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: A FEW CLUSTERS OF STRONG STORMS PERSIST EARLY THIS EVENING WITH WIDESPREAD WIND GUSTS ON THE ORDER OF 20-30 KT. AN ISOLATED 50-60 MPH WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN THE WLY FLOW REGIME ALOFT AND VERY MOIST AIR MASS. DESPITE LOSS OF HEATING...ONGOING STORMS ARE ENTERING INTO A MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS PER 00Z SOUNDINGS...THUS HAVE INTRODUCED A 5 PERCENT WIND AREA FOR THE COASTAL AREAS THIS EVENING. ..JEWELL.. 09/11/2015

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS NRN IL AND POSSIBLY FAR NW IND. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY ACROSS THE MCD AREA THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EXTENDING FROM WRN IL INTO SW LOWER MI ALONG WHICH SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 50S TO MID 60S F. THE ATMOSPHERE ACROSS NRN IL HAS DESTABILIZED AS SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE UPPER 70S AND LOWER 80S F ACROSS PARTS OF THE MCD AREA. A LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE LINE IS ONGOING IN NRN IL ALONG THE MOIST AXIS WHERE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE CONVERGENCE IS LOCALLY MAXIMIZED ACCORDING TO MESOSCALE ANALYSIS. THE WSR-88D VWP IN THE VICINITY OF THE LINE NEAR CHICAGO SHOWS ABOUT 40 KT OF WLY FLOW ABOVE 3 KM. THIS COMBINED WITH A SEWD MOVEMENT OF 25 TO 30 KT COULD ENABLE THE STRONGER CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE TO BECOME MARGINALLY SEVERE THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THE LINE MOVES SEWD ALONG A GRADIENT OF INSTABILITY. THE CELLS ON THE SWRN END OF THE LINE OVER NCNTRL IL WILL PROBABLY HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT DUE TO THE CLOSE PROXIMITY OF MODERATE INSTABILITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: FORECAST CONFIDENCE CONTINUES TO INCREASE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERE STORMS BETWEEN 19-21Z IN VICINITY OF I-80 BETWEEN NORTH PLATTE /LBF/ AND GRAND ISLAND /GRI/ NEB. VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT...THOUGH STRONG WIND GUSTS AND A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY. MEANWHILE...ISOLATED STRONG TO POSSIBLY SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL KS WITH HAIL APPROACHING 1 INCH IN DIAMETER AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LIGHTNING DATA AND MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS DEVELOPING ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL KS...GENERALLY NEAR AND EAST OF A DRY LINE WHICH EXTENDED FROM THE NEB/KS BORDER /SOUTHEAST OF MCK/ SSWWD TO JUST EAST OF HLC TO WEST OF DDC INTO CENTRAL PORTIONS OF THE OK/NORTH TX PANHANDLES. STRONG SURFACE HEATING HAS ALLOWED CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES IN THE MIDDLE 80S TO BE REACHED...WHILE WAA LOCATED AROUND 700 MB APPEARS TO BE AIDING IN THE KS TSTM DEVELOPMENT. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO STRENGTHEN FROM NORTH-SOUTH ACROSS KS WITH THE APPROACH OF AN UPSTREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH...SUCH THAT THE STORMS ACROSS NORTHERN KS WILL HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL TO BECOME STRONG TO SEVERE IN THE SHORT TERM. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED AN INCREASING CU FIELD ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL NEB...WHILE RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A FEW CELLS FORMING FROM CUSTER/SHERMAN/BUFFALO COUNTIES TO WEBSTER COUNTY. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY BE INFLUENCED BY THE 700-MB WARM AIR ADVECTION... THOUGH AN INCREASE IN DEEP-LAYER ASCENT WITH THE APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND 500-MB SPEED MAX...AND LIFT ALONG THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT SUGGEST TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BECOME MORE VIGOROUS AND INCREASE IN COVERAGE. LAST SEVERAL RUNS OF THE OPERATIONAL HRRR SUGGEST STORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY BETWEEN LBF-GRI...WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING TO THE S/SE THROUGH SOUTHERN NEB INTO NORTHERN KS. MODERATE INSTABILITY SOUTH OF THE COLD FRONT...STRENGTHENING BULK SHEAR AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL THE PRIMARY THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS ERN KS...FAR NE OK AND WCNTRL MO LATE THIS AFTERNOON. HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS THE MCD AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A PRONOUNCED CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EXTENDING NNEWD FROM NE OK INTO FAR ERN KS AND WRN MO WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE CURRENTLY IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS ERN KS AND WRN MO WITH MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS. THUNDERSTORMS HAVE BEEN INCREASING IN COVERAGE ALONG THIS CORRIDOR OVER THE LAST COUPLE OF HOURS NEAR THE INSTABILITY MAX. THE ACTIVITY IS DEVELOPING IN THE WAKE OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY OVER SRN MO. THIS FEATURE WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE AWAY FROM THE MCD AREA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AS A RESULT...INCREASING SUBSIDENCE MAY INHIBIT VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE UPDRAFT GROWTH. HOWEVER...THE SPRINGFIELD MO WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 30 KT SUGGESTING THAT THE WIND SHEAR ENVIRONMENT MAY BE ENOUGH TO SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT. THIS COMBINED WITH THE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. HAIL COULD ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS CROSSING PORTIONS OF THE PIEDMONT AND COASTAL PLAIN OF THE CAROLINAS AND VA MAY PRODUCE A FEW INSTANCES OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS...THOUGH SVR WIND GUSTS WILL BE UNLIKELY. WW ISSUANCE WILL NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF TSTMS EVOLVING ALONG THE PIEDMONT FROM VA TO SC WILL CONTINUE BEING STEERED EWD/NEWD TOWARD THE COAST...WITH TSTM-PRECEDING STRONG SFC HEATING HAVING STEEPENED LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AMIDST AMPLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. MODESTLY ENHANCED MID-LEVEL FLOW PERIPHERAL TO THE TROUGH IS SUPPORTING 25-30 KT OF EFFECTIVE-BULK SHEAR...SUFFICIENT FOR WEAKLY ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED TSTMS WITH A FEW SPORADIC INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW AND POOR MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL GREATLY REDUCE THE RISK FOR SVR WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR INCREASING POTENTIAL OF ISOLATED SVR TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON...CONTINUING INTO THE EVENING. WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS IMAGERY DEPICTS BANDS OF AGITATED CU FIELDS ALONG SFC TROUGHS ANALYZED NE/SW OVER SERN CO INTO NM AND OVER PARTS OF WRN KS. TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING IN PROXIMITY TO THESE FEATURES...AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO BLOSSOM AS ASCENT PRECEDING A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE APPROACHES FROM THE NW...WITH EVOLVING ACTIVITY SPREADING SEWD THROUGH THE EVENING. STRONG DIURNAL HEATING AMIDST MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE HAS BRED DEEP PBL CIRCULATIONS OVER THE AREA YIELDING SFC TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS OF 30-40F AND DCAPE AROUND 1400-1600 J/KG...ALLOWING TSTMS TO OFFER SOME SVR-WIND POTENTIAL. ISOLATED SVR HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR OWING TO STEEP TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES IN PLACE. VWPS SAMPLE A MODEST ENHANCEMENT TO MID-LEVEL FLOW OVER THE AREA...ALLOWING FOR SOME CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION/SUSTENANCE. HOWEVER...STRONGER DEEP SHEAR/FORCING FOR ASCENT SHOULD RESIDE N OF THE DISCUSSION AREA...PREVENTING MORE THAN AN ISOLATED SVR RISK FROM EVOLVING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL AND SOUTHWEST KANSAS MAY ALSO INTENSIFY AND A WATCH IS POSSIBLE IN THIS AREA PRIOR TO 2330Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL STORM WAS LOCATED OVER ROOKS COUNTY KS AT 2210Z...WITH A LOOSELY-ORGANIZED LINE OF SEVERE STORMS ALONG I-80 IN CENTRAL NEB. LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A DRYLINE EXTENDING ACROSS WESTERN KS AND INTERSECTING AN EAST-WEST FRONTAL BOUNDARY NEAR THE KS-NEB BORDER IN THE VICINITY OF THE ROOKS COUNTY STORM...WHERE MODERATE-STRONG SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY WAS PRESENT. RECENT VWP DATA FROM KUEX REVEALS SUBSTANTIAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /45 KTS IN THE 0-6 KM LAYER/ AND THE ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN CONDUCIVE FOR LARGE HAIL...PERHAPS VERY LARGE...AND DAMAGING WINDS INTO THE EVENING HOURS. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS ACROSS NEB IN THE WAKE OF THUNDERSTORM PASSAGE REFLECT SUBSTANTIAL COOLING/COLD POOL GENERATION...AND WITH TIME THE STORMS MAY POSE AN INCREASING THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST KANSAS AS OUTFLOW CONGEAL. THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING/INTENSIFYING ACROSS WESTERN KANSAS...WHERE WEAK-MODERATE SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY WAS PRESENT WITHIN A WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...AND 40-50 KTS OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS...AND WATCH ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SVR TSTMS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 509...WITH AN ISOLATED SVR RISK PERHAPS EXTENDING OUTSIDE OF THE WW DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS OFFERING SVR HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL CONTINUE FROM NESS COUNTY KS TO STANTON COUNTY KS...WITH THE SRN EXTENT OF THIS ACTIVITY SHOWING SIGNS OF BACKBUILDING INTO BACA COUNTY CO. VOLUMETRIC RADAR DATA IMPLY SUPERCELLULAR STRUCTURES ONGOING...CONSISTENT WITH THE 00Z DDC RAOB THAT SAMPLED 35-40 KT OF DEEP SHEAR CHARACTERIZED BY VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT IN A DEEP PBL -- EXTENDING TO AROUND 9 KFT AGL. ASSOCIATED DCAPE AROUND 1500 J/KG AND LARGE SUB-CLOUD TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS SUGGEST STRONG OUTFLOW FOSTERING SVR-WIND POTENTIAL...WHILE MODERATELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND THE AFOREMENTIONED DEEP SHEAR SUPPORT SVR HAIL POTENTIAL. THE SVR RISK WILL SPREAD SEWD/SSEWD DURING THE EVENING HOURS...POTENTIALLY E OF THE WW IN S-CNTRL KS AND SWD INTO THE OK/TX PANHANDLES AND NWRN OK. WHILE ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED...LOCAL SPATIAL EXTENSION OF WW 509 MAY BE POSSIBLE IN KS. WITH THE DDC RAOB SAMPLING A MEAN MIXING RATIO AROUND 9 G/KG...THE DEARTH OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD BE ASSOCIATED WITH NOTABLE GAINS IN MLCIN BEYOND DUSK...SUGGESTING A LIMITED-COVERAGE SVR RISK LATER THIS EVENING AND THE LACK OF ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE. ..COHEN.. 09/11/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA. A NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED DOWNSTREAM ACROSS PORTIONS OF EASTERN AND SOUTHERN KANSAS AND SOUTHWEST MISSOURI BY 01Z/8 PM CDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS EXHIBITING SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS WERE IN PROGRESS AT 0030Z ALONG A COMPOSITE EAST-WEST FRONTAL BOUNDARY OVER NORTHERN/CENTRAL KANSAS. A SMALL CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS WAS ALSO LOCATED OVER EAST-CENTRAL KANSAS IN THE VICINITY OF A NORTHWARD-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE LARGE-SCALE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS SUPPORTIVE OF A CONTINUED SEVERE RISK...WITH MODERATE-STRONG SURFACE-BASED BUOYANCY AND AMPLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH AN UPPER LEVEL IMPULSE OVER SOUTHERN NEBRASKA AND KANSAS WILL AID IN ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT...PRIMARILY ALONG CONSOLIDATING OUTFLOWS GENERALLY ALONG I-70 FROM MANHATTAN TO NEAR TOPEKA. STORMS WILL CONTINUE MOVING SOUTHEAST THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING HOURS WITH A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL. GIVEN FAVORABLE CONDITIONS IN THE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT...A NEW WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED OVER PORTIONS OF EASTERN KANSAS AND FAR SOUTHWEST MISSOURI BY 01Z. ..BUNTING.. 09/11/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TSTMS MAY OCCUR THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS...AND AN ISOLATED SVR TSTM CANNOT BE RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE WILL NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY ACROSS PARTS OF THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY/VICINITY WELL IN ADVANCE OF A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAX PROGRESSING ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS. THE 00Z DVN RAOB SAMPLED AROUND 1200-1500 J/KG OF MUCAPE AIDED BY THE INFLUX OF MODERATELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...COMBINED WITH AROUND 55 KT OF EFFECTIVE-BULK SHEAR. HAIL -- POSSIBLY REACHING MARGINALLY SVR LEVELS ON AN ISOLATED BASIS -- MAY OCCUR WITH THIS ACTIVITY...THOUGH DEEP ASCENT IS FORECAST TO REMAIN LIMITED ATOP ONLY MODEST THETA-E IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER MITIGATED BY NOCTURNAL COOLING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES WITH BOWING STORM SEGMENTS ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PRONOUNCED BOWING SEGMENT PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS WAS LOCATED OVER EAST-CENTRAL KANSAS AT 0315Z...WITH THE STRONGEST WINDS OVER MIAMI COUNTY. THE TRAILING PORTION OF THE LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING SOUTHWEST TO THE WICHITA AREA CONTAINS A FEW INTENSE UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SEVERE HAIL. A SECOND SMALLER BOWING COMPLEX OF STORMS WAS LOCATED WEST/NORTHWEST OF WICHITA.
